ocr_text: Team Management O Effective team management is crucial for a small cleaning business. Oo Focus on ensuring teams are managed effectively.\nOperations Management 4+ O Financial Management Oo Managing finances effectively is a key responsibility. O Keep up with financial aspects of the business.\nSmall Business Management ~~ - Legal and Regulatory Compliance O Staying updated on laws, regulations, and taxes is essential. O Ensure compliance with all relevant legal requirements.\nComprehensive Business Oversight The founder and owner needs a holistic approach to running the business. Consider all aspects to avoid missing important elements.\nO Visualizing Business Processes Oo Employing a visual way to think through business operations is beneficial. O Helps in identifying any overlooked areas.
